summary: This class models the Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) page for HP Smart application testing. It inherits from SmartFlow and provides comprehensive test automation methods for device management workflows. The class is organized into two main sections: VERIFICATION FLOWS (methods that verify UI elements are present/visible) and ACTION FLOWS (methods that perform user interactions). Key patterns include: 1) Extensive use of driver.wait_for_object() for element synchronization with configurable timeouts and exception handling, 2) Verification methods for multi-screen popup flows (What's New popup with three screens), 3) Text extraction methods for validating popup content, 4) Click actions for navigation and interaction, 5) Special handling for edge cases like Windows dummy printer (alpha code workaround) and JavaScript-based clicks for hidden elements, 6) Support for logged-in/logged-out states verification. The class demonstrates robust test automation practices with explicit waits, parameterized timeouts, and flexible error handling through raise_e parameters.
